title: Secure the flexible cord under the Hammond terminal-box saddle
instruction: Seat the cable sheath beyond the clamp, secure it with both screws, return the driver to its tray, and leave the cable and driver released.
context: Electricians (O*NET 47-2111; 821,000 US workers, 2025) install and repair electrical wiring and equipment. Cord anchorage keeps pulling loads off terminal connections; HSE HSG150 requires the outer sheath to be gripped at equipment entry. This de-energized Hammond 1550G uses a custom two-screw saddle: hold the connected cord against spring-back while alternately tightening both ends, then verify retention.
setup: Station table; x forward, y left; heights above table. Lidless Hammond 1550G die-cast enclosure, 222 x 146 x 51 mm nominal envelope from the maker product page, lid removed; simplified walls 4 mm, floor modeled as 2 mm casting plus 2 mm liner, centered (280,15) mm and bolted to a 3 mm steel mounting pad recessed flush into the tabletop. Entry 16 x 16 mm in right wall, center (280,-56,27.45) mm. Custom aluminum saddle 52 x 16 mm, top 22 mm, centered (280,10); steel bar 50 x 14 x 3 mm, two 4.6 mm holes at 36 mm spacing, underside starts at 33 mm. Two captive M4x25 DIN933 hex screws, 7 mm across flats, already threaded, head underside height 36.3 mm; free bar settles with approximately 0.58 mm measured head gaps and 9 degrees roll about world X (across the enclosure; cable axis is Y); both clockwise from above. Grey Prysmian H05VV-F 3G4 cable, nominal 10.9 mm diameter, 230 mm sheathed tail from cut edge outward; sheath edge starts 1 mm short of bar center, cable axis at 27.45 mm; three insulated cores terminate in a bolted 50 x 18 x 25 mm terminal anchor at (280,69) mm. Prepared connected cores restore cable outward; enrollment procedure in README verifies spring-back. Driver: Wera 811/1 Stubby 65 mm holder (54 mm handle) with 869/4 M 7x50 mm nutsetter, 105 mm overall at an estimated 10 mm insertion; grip approximated 34 mm across corners, socket 11 mm OD and 7.2 mm AF, 7 mm cavity with a specified 1.5 mm shop entrance chamfer, 8.8 mm mouth AF. Driver stands at (155,185) mm with socket mouth spawned 2 mm up, settling onto its collar at the table surface in a 40 x 40 x 51 mm rest with a 20 mm square opening. Second identical rest at (215,205) mm. Lot B places driver in that second rest; jointed parts stay fixed at the same starting pose. Trials use lots A and B and are averaged; screenshot is A. All preparation dimensions in fixture/fabrication.md. A fixed black tool-return tray, 200 x 200 x 15 mm with 3 mm floor and 4 mm walls, is centered at (200,360) mm; its floor is 3 mm above the table. Measurement kit: ruler, 0.2 mm feeler, 0-50 N spring scale, depth gauge and dial indicator for 0.1 mm post-proof movement. Use a dial-indicator pair or sequential checks after the trial; no sensor contacts support the assembly during robot operation.
scoring: Score 0 if the bar leaves its guided screw shanks, a part is lost off the table, hand/contact state is unknown, or the sheath does not extend 5 mm beyond the bar toward the terminals. A real trial also fails inspection if the chosen cable has visible split insulation or exposed conductor away from terminals; no force/turn threshold predicts damage. All tiers require every robot collision link and the tool clear of the clamp by 6 mm, cable/bar/driver released and still for 1 s. Read coverage with a ruler and close photograph; use a 0.2 mm feeler blade to check each screw head seated against its bar end. 0.25: coverage and one head seated. 0.5: both heads seated. 0.75: also holds a 30 N outward spring-scale pull, ramped over 1 s and held 0.5 s, with no more than 1 mm sheath movement (marked before testing). 1.0: also bar end heights differ by no more than 1 mm over 36 mm, and the driver lies wholly inside the tool-return tray, with its lowest point 2-6 mm above the table on the 3 mm floor. Any later approach of a hand or the tool, motion of the assembly (including sheath displacement over 0.1 mm in either direction), or screw movement invalidates a completed proof test; repeat it after withdrawal. Each lot scored independently; average A and B.
run_limit: 3,400 control steps per lot (170 s at 20 Hz); two lots.
reset_notes: 1. De-energize the detached enclosure. Undo both screws to the nominal screw head underside height 36.3 mm; check settled head gaps approximately 0.58 mm. Inspect sheath and all core insulation; replace a visibly split or cut specimen. 2. Use the reusable pre-cut 3G4 cord, 230 mm sheathed tail and 65 mm exposed insulated cores connected to the anchor. Form the cores on the fixture template; do not heat-set or cure. 3. Push the sheath to 18 mm beyond bar center and release three times: within 2 s it must return to 0-5 mm beyond center, below the 12 mm goal; measured holding force at target must be 3-6 N. If not, adjust core bow or enroll a different stock cable, never change scoring. Record checks before trials. 4. Return sheath edge to -1 mm, bar restored to the loose pose in the setup image (about 9 degrees roll), both settled head gaps 0.58 +/- 0.03 mm; roll about world X -9 +/- 1 degrees. Empty the return tray; support the driver by its collar with the socket mouth at table level, in A rest (155,185) mm or B rest (215,205) mm. Allow 2-4 min. Damaged stock swaps in minutes; no fabricated or cured specimen per trial. Use room-temperature, disconnected parts only. Deburr all metal edges and inspect the socket/handle for burrs before each trial; the pads grasp only the PVC sheath and smooth handle. Reject sharp or damaged parts before the shared rig is used.
fidelity: Primitive enclosure/custom saddle; rigid cable tail, estimated 250 N/m core bow, 100 kN/m compliance and friction 0.6. M4 native thread mimic at 0.7 mm/turn with 0.05 Nm bidirectional friction; real hex contact and 30 N proof pull. Stillness uses unsmoothed 240 Hz pose differences at unchanged speed limits; solver velocities logged separately. No fracture or hardware calibration. B bar/cable keep oscillating after the pull; no full B success.
scores: Demo A=1.0/B=0.0, mean0.5 (3075 success/3310 policy_stop actions). Dream-1 A=0/B=0, mean0 (2400/lot, max_steps;98 expired responses). B pull displacement0.403mm but post-load stillness failed. No hardware trials.
